Rule 11 of the "Casa mea 3D" constitution is the one I needed. I've found it and can answer now.

Rule 11 keeps out PostGIS, IFC, AR, OCR and multi-country support in the early phases. The rule's wording is "Fără infrastructură complexă fără nevoie reală", which means no complex infrastructure without a real need. The file is a Romanian-language "non-negotiable rules" list for the Casa mea 3D app. I read it directly from the repository.

ANSWER_PATH: 02_PRODUCT/projects/workspaces/casa3d/app/CONSTITUTION.md
ANSWER: Rule 11: "Fără infrastructură complexă fără nevoie reală (fără PostGIS, IFC, AR, OCR, multi-țară în fazele timpurii)." In English: PostGIS, IFC, AR, OCR and multi-country support are kept out of the early phases.
